title: Count Prefix and Suffix Pairs I
summary: Given a 0-indexed array of string words, count the number of index pairs (i, j) where i < j and the function isPrefixAndSuffix(words[i], words[j]) returns true, indicating words[i] is both a prefix and a suffix of words[j].
statement: Given a 0-indexed array of string words, count the number of index pairs (i, j) where i < j and the function isPrefixAndSuffix(words[i], words[j]) returns true, indicating words[i] is both a prefix and a suffix of words[j].
constraints: For every index pair i<j, inspect words[i] and words[j].
The pair qualifies when words[i] is both a prefix and a suffix of words[j].
Return the number of qualifying index pairs, counting repeated words by position.
hints: The source-I limits permit checking every ordered index pair.
Use startswith and endswith for the two border conditions.
Count only when both hold and i is strictly before j.
Every allowable pair is visited once, and the two predicates directly implement the definition.
editorial: Every allowable pair is visited once, and the two predicates directly implement the definition.

tests.explanation: pa borders papa and ma borders mama, giving two pairs.
